note: Kootenai NF (Three Rivers RD), small campground on Hwy 508 NW of Troy, adjacent to Red Top Creek. A 24-ft trailer recommendation was recorded from a secondary source; limited maneuvering room. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page (updated Apr 30, 2026): confirmed 3 sites, free (pack in/pack out), no drinking water, vault toilet (amenity box contradicts the description); added year-round availability (managed Memorial Day - Labor Day). Not stated: trailer length (derived 24 ft left), stay limit (derived 14 left; page points to regional stay-limit alerts), reservations. Kootenai flood-washout alert lists no road near Hwy 508. Note trimmed of restated values.
